code:
import ipaddress

TABLE = [
    ("0.0.0.0", 0, "10.0.0.1", "default"),
    ("192.168.0.0", 16, "10.0.0.2", "aggregate /16"),
    ("192.168.10.0", 24, "10.0.0.3", "site /24"),
    ("192.168.10.128", 25, "10.0.0.4", "subnet A /25"),
    ("192.168.10.64", 26, "10.0.0.5", "subnet B /26"),
    ("10.0.0.0", 8, "10.0.0.6", "private /8"),
]

def match(dst):
    ip = ipaddress.ip_address(dst)
    hits = []
    for pref, plen, nh, tag in TABLE:
        net = ipaddress.ip_network(f"{pref}/{plen}", strict=False)
        if ip in net:
            hits.append((plen, nh, tag))
    hits.sort(reverse=True)
    print(f"destination {dst}")
    for plen, nh, tag in hits:
        print(f"    match /{plen:<2}  nexthop={nh:<9} {tag}")
    best = hits[0]
    print(f"    CHOSEN /{best[0]} -> {best[1]}  ({best[2]})")
    print()

print("=== longest prefix match ===")
for dst in ("192.168.10.130", "192.168.10.200", "192.168.10.70", "8.8.8.8", "10.5.5.5"):
    match(dst)

print("=== route aggregation (supernet) ===")
blocks = ["192.168.0.0/24", "192.168.1.0/24", "192.168.2.0/24", "192.168.3.0/24"]
agg = ipaddress.collapse_addresses([ipaddress.ip_network(b) for b in blocks])
print("  inputs :", ", ".join(blocks))
print("  merged :", ", ".join(str(a) for a in agg))
print("  4 routes -> 1 route, prefix 24 -> 22, table shrinks 4x")
